name: codex-lsp-plugin
description: Language Server Protocol tools, post-edit diagnostics, and staged pre-commit checks for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Adds local LSP diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, safe renames, post-edit checks, and deterministic staged-file pre-commit validation.
